limitations: Scores are provisional browser assessments based on the supplied sheets and runtime narrative; no additional files, source, prior rounds or graders were inspected.
For each item, A is the mean of hierarchy, typography and surfaces; F is the mean of clarity, feedback and accessibility, excluding genuinely inapplicable null values.

The authorized A>=9 and F>=9 threshold is not met; recurring browser presentation weaknesses include constrained-editor line clipping, dense centered explanations and inconsistent physical integration of controls.
No hard-gate failure is established by these captures and supplied runtime evidence; content beyond a scroll viewport is not itself proof of an unreachable action.

Supplied browser evidence supports draft preservation, recovery, keyboard navigation, contrast, reduced motion and performance, but does not provide directly inspected pressed-state evidence for every control.
Static transition frames show composition changes but cannot independently establish continuous camera quality, parallax, independent painted layers or animation smoothness.
Some captures are deliberately scrolled or constrained; black sheet padding and missing offscreen content were not treated as standalone implementation failures.
Physical iPhone, VoiceOver, native keyboard, haptics, tilt, actual purchase flows, native notification delivery and OS share-sheet behavior remain deferred without blanket browser-score deductions.
Connected circles behavior is not demonstrated; billing and the native sharing boundary are simulated.
Synthetic predictions, repeated explanation fixtures and test dates establish layout coverage only, not model quality or production-content quality.
topFixes: Reclaim editing height at 200% in 500px viewports and prevent partial glyph lines at input boundaries.
Break long centered explanations into short sections with descriptive subheads and clearer disclosure boundaries.
Strengthen physical depth with consistent contact shadows, material thickness and edge lighting on tables, buttons and room destinations.
Compact enlarged onboarding, subject and check-in heading stacks so related inputs and confirmation actions stay closer together.
Give city results, secondary actions and fallback URLs clearer bounded surfaces while preserving centered text.
Keep the forecast visually dominant over replay, sharing and other secondary actions.
